title: Design System: CRETO Ingeniería y Construcciones

red-hover.note: Hover only; white on it passes AA only for large text.

ink-3.note: Scrollbar thumb only; 1.30:1 on ink-0, never used for text.

text-3.note: Also the process numerals (01-04) and the muted CRETO brand word in service names.

on-red.note: All text on red, including secondary text (solid #fff, never translucent); white button fill.

display.purpose: Home hero headline only; uppercase, two masked lines, max 18ch.

title.purpose: Tertiary headings; project card titles in the same voice, "Tipo · Lugar" split onto two lines.

title-sm.purpose: Promise items, process steps, method items, form title, spec-sheet values (1.375rem to 1.875rem).

lead.purpose: Intro paragraph under headlines; text-2, max 38rem.

small.purpose: Notes, meta, footer lists, hero foot line.

shadows.name: float-lift
shadows.purpose: WhatsApp float only; the system is otherwise flat.

overlays.name: header-glass
overlays.purpose: Header after 24px scroll or with menu open.

overlays.name: closing-media-blend
overlays.value: position: absolute; right: 0; width: 46%; mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: 0.55; drawing lines rgba(11,11,10,0.55), accent line #fff
overlays.purpose: Closing CTA red field: media sits on the right, multiplied into the red; no gradient.

overlays.name: closing-media-blend
overlays.value: position: absolute; right: 0; width: 46%; mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: 0.55; drawing lines rgba(11,11,10,0.55), accent line #fff

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions and reveals.

motion.name: row-sweep
motion.purpose: Service row red field scaleY from bottom.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: [data-reveal] blocks via IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.12, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0); stagger via --d (70-180ms steps).

motion.name: hero-line
motion.purpose: Masked hero headline lines on load.

motion.name: step-rule
motion.purpose: Red rule over each process step.

motion.name: promise-words
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked word illumination from 92% viewport to block centre at 45%.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Final states shown, drawings fully traced, word split skipped, smooth scroll off. Start states scoped to html.js, added by an inline <head> script in every HTML entry (initLayout() re-adds it), so no-JS renders fully visible.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: 4-col grids to 2; 3-col footer (1.4fr 0.8fr 1.2fr) to 2 cols; spec sheet 3 cols.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Nav to full-screen menu; header 68px; splits, heads, contact, prose, service rows stack; cards full width.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Most grids single column (footer stays 2 cols, brand spans both); hero/closing buttons full width; padding cleared for WhatsApp float; body 1rem.

layoutNotes.whatsappFloat: Hidden on contacto (body.page-contacto) and while the mobile menu is open.

narrative.overview:
This is a corporate builder site at full scale: a concrete-black ground, warm off-white type, and the brand red used as whole fields rather than as sprinkled accents. The professional benchmark is conconcreto.com. It plays the category standard straight and with full craft, and it refuses the light SaaS template: no pill badges, no eyebrow kickers, no card grids of icon plus title. Hierarchy comes from scale. Huge condensed uppercase display lines carry the claims, a quiet humanist grotesk carries the explanations, and thin hairline rules divide everything. There are no boxes or shadows.

The red is reserved for moments of commitment: the budget promise band, the closing call-to-action band, the primary "Cotiza por WhatsApp" action, the sweep behind a service row on hover, the progress rule on each process step, and the active underline in navigation. Everything else stays in three tones of black and three tones of off-white. Imagery runs full-bleed, edge to edge, under dark gradients; on the red closing band it is instead multiplied into the red on the right side. Until real photographs exist, each photo slot draws a technical line drawing (elevation, section, floor plan or hillside retaining wall) that traces itself onto the screen. These drawings are honest stand-ins and must not be read as fake photos.

Motion is confident and slow: long out-expo easings, masked line reveals on page load, blocks that rise into view, and one signature interaction, the budget promise lighting up word by word as you scroll across the red field. All content is visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground (`ink-0`) with three tonal steps for surfaces; no shadows except on the floating WhatsApp button.
Brand red appears as whole fields and full-height sweeps, never as decorative tints.
Archivo condensed (width 78%) at weight 800, uppercase for display and hero; Hanken Grotesk for all text.
Hairline rules (`line`, `line-strong`) structure lists, rows, steps and footers instead of cards.
Corners are almost square (4px); the only round element is the WhatsApp float.
Line-drawing placeholders that trace on reveal, swapped for photos by editing `src/data/site.ts`.

rules.name: The Whole-Field Rule
rules.body: Red is applied as a complete surface: a full section band (promise, closing CTA), a full button, a full-height row sweep, a 2px rule at full width. Red text on black, red-tinted cards and red gradients are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Three-Tone Ground Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from moving one step along `ink-0` → `ink-1` → `ink-2`, never from shadows or lighter greys.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo is always condensed (78% or 85%) and heavy (750–800). Hanken Grotesk is always the reading voice. Archivo is never set at regular width or weight, and Hanken Grotesk is never used for display.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. There are no small uppercase eyebrow labels above them. The only brand-word device is "CRETO" inside service names (inline and muted in rows, a block line on service pages), and it is part of the name itself.

rules.name: The Gradient-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Legibility over imagery comes from ink gradients (or, on red, from a multiplied image kept to one side), never from boxes, shadows or text-shadows.

dos: Do use `red` as a whole surface (a band, a button, a full-height sweep or a 2px full-width rule) and keep it for commitment moments and the WhatsApp action.
Do set display type in Archivo at `font-stretch: 78%`, weight 800, line-height 0.94, -0.02em tracking, uppercase for hero, closing and promise lines, and balance-wrapped with a `ch` max width.
Do divide content with 1px hairlines (`line`, `line-strong`) and tone shifts (`ink-0` to `ink-1`) instead of cards and shadows.

Do run imagery full-bleed under ink gradients (on the red closing band, multiplied on the right instead), and route every photo through `mediaHTML()` so empty slots fall back to the traced line drawing.
Do add real photos by copying them into `public/fotos/` and writing their paths in the `fotos` object in `src/data/site.ts` (horizontal JPG, about 2400px wide).
Do mark every example project with `ejemplo: true` so it shows the `Ejemplo` / `Proyecto de ejemplo` tag.
Do scope animation start states under `html.js` and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep a 4px radius on interactive and media elements and a 2px red focus outline at a 3px offset.
donts: Don't put eyebrow kickers or small uppercase labels above headings.
Don't use pill badges or grids of icon plus title cards; the light SaaS template is the confirmed anti-reference.
Don't show invented testimonials, reviews, projects or team data as real, and don't add new figures or claims beyond those already on the site.
Don't show certifications or credentials (no credential strips, credential lists or "respaldado por" columns) unless the client re-approves them.
Don't use red as text on black, as a tint or as a gradient.
Don't add drop shadows; the WhatsApp float is the single exception.
Don't set Archivo at normal width or regular weight, or use Hanken Grotesk for display.
Don't put resting text on `red-hover`; white on it is 4.23:1 and is only used for hover.
